notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Zombies.
description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Zombie you control.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If you control four or more Zombies as the combo begins, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.
